exposure: Availability of infrastructure, human resources, surgical interventions, equipment, and supplies
outcome: Capacity of Bangladeshi government-run hospitals to provide emergency and essential surgical, obstetric, and anesthetic services
cohort: 240 Bangladeshi Government healthcare facilities (218 sub-district and 22 district/general hospitals)
finding: While Bangladesh has made progress in providing essential surgical services, equipment and infrastructure shortages persist, particularly at sub-district hospitals.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was offered by 55% of sub-district hospitals and 95% of district/general hospitals.
